tools.name: humanize-comment
tools.description: Draft + Context + Guidance → 5 writers (Qwen3.8 Novelist/friend, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash/forum, Gemma-4-12B Starry Ocean/peer (was Cydonia-24B v4.3 until its 2026-11-18 delisting; Starry Ocean was the … text:Draft -> text:Context -> text:Guidance -> join:Context+Guidance -> join:Writer input -> join:Judge: context+original -> llm:Writer A (Qwen3.8-27B Novelist, voice: friend) -> llm:Writer B (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, voice: forum) -> llm:Writer C (Gemma-4-12B Starry Ocean, voice: peer) -> llm:Writer D (Qwen3.8-27B antislop, voice: plain) -> llm:Writer E (Hy4 Flash, voice: quick) -> join:Judge: +A -> join:Judge: +B -> join:Judge: +C -> join:Judge: +D -> join:Judge: +E -> llm:Decider (GLM-5.3); returns text. Runs on NanoGPT — a deposit is quoted for each request from its length and maxChars and caps what the customer pays; it settles at the lesser of the metered cost plus 20% and that deposit, and any difference is returned; the operator absorbs any overrun. When a writer's fallback model runs, both calls are charged. This refund and cap apply to hosted payments. Direct-wallet spending has no cap; last run $0.004, ~36s.

Guidance.description: Text; default: "a friendly, specific reply"; optional; at most 600 characters; a leading one-thread prefix ("One thread: ONE main point, each sentence follows the last, 2-4 sentences <450 chars, <=1 hash/address, <=1 question at end, no 'Catch:' labels.") is not counted

keep.description: optional; verbatim spans (a joke, a closing line) that must survive exactly. Each span is swapped for a placeholder before the rewrite and put back after. Every match in the draft counts, and the placeholder draft must stay within the draft cap. Overlapping keeps are protected together so each one survives. A rewrite that drops, duplicates, or changes a span is rejected. At most 8 spans, each at most 500 characters.

ending.description: optional; where the rewrite must end. "question" ends with a question. "keep_last" ends with the last keep span, or with the draft's final sentence when keep is omitted. "any" leaves the ending free. default: "any"

maxChars.description: optional; hard cap on the rewrite length in characters (1 to 5000). Every copy of a keep span counts toward the cap. Over-length rewrites are rejected and that writer is asked once more.

title.description: optional; when true, writers are asked for one title line rather than a comment; paragraph-length replies are rejected and that writer is asked once more. Default false: a short draft is not treated as a title on its own.

tools.name: sfw_check
tools.description: Say whether an image, or evenly sampled frames of a video, is safe for work. One yes/no decision per picture (perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2). The check passes only when every picture is yes. Video sampling needs ffmpeg on the server; a still image does not. There is no switch to skip this check. Runs on NanoGPT — a deposit is quoted for each request from how many pictures it checks and is a cap on the charge; it settles at the metered cost plus 20% or the quote, whichever is less, and a picture that would exceed the remaining budget is not checked; the difference is returned.

image.description: optional; still image — https URL or data URL. At most 4 MB. A hosted server does not read local files. Does not use ffmpeg.

video.description: optional; video — https URL or data URL. Frames are sampled evenly. At most 4 MB. Needs ffmpeg. A hosted server does not read local files.

frames.description: optional; how many video frames to check (1–8, default 5). Ignored when there is no video.

tools.name: run_noodle
tools.description: Run any nanoodle workflow: pass a share link as `url` (a nanoodle.com/#g=… workflow link, a nanoodle.com/play.html#a=… app link) OR a custom workflow graph you composed as `graph`, plus any workflow inputs as `inputs`. Design with noodle_guide, check the estimated cost with price_noodle (free), then run it here. Runs on NanoGPT — paid in NEAR or USDC on mainnet: a deposit is held up front, you are charged the actual model cost + 20% service fee, and the rest is refunded automatically — call price_noodle first for the itemized estimate. This paid server refuses short links, media inputs and node types it cannot price (see noodle_guide).

url.description: A full nanoodle share link with its #g=, #j= or #a= fragment (short links are refused here). Pass url OR graph.

graph.description: A custom workflow graph you composed: { "nodes": [{ "id", "type", "name"?, "fields": {...} }], "links": [{ "from": { "node", "port" }, "to": { "node", "port" } }] } (an object, or the same as a JSON string). Call noodle_guide for the node types, ports and priced models. Pass url OR graph.

inputs.description: Text inputs keyed by input name, e.g. { "Idea": "a lighthouse at dawn" }; this paid server accepts no media inputs. Omit to use the graph's saved text.

_pay_with.description: Choose the payment asset. Default near; usdc pays and refunds Circle-issued USDC on NEAR.

_payment_id.description: The paymentId from this tool's quote. After the pay page confirms payment, repeat the original arguments plus this id. Agents paying directly also supply _payment_tx and _payment_sender.

_payment_tx.description: Hash (base58) of the exact quoted payment: one native Transfer for NEAR, or one ft_transfer on the quoted token contract for USDC.

_payment_sender.description: The NEAR account you paid from. It locates the transaction; the refund goes to the transaction's signer.

tools.name: price_noodle
tools.description: Free, never charged: price a workflow before you run it. Takes the same `url` OR `graph` and `inputs` as run_noodle and returns the estimated cost (itemized per paid node: node, model, basis, USD), the 20% service fee on the actual cost, the deposit a paid server would hold (the most a run can be charged), the likely refund, and every problem that would stop the graph from running; iterate until pricing.safety.ok is true. It never runs anything and creates no payment. Workflow: design with noodle_guide → price_noodle → run_noodle.

url.description: A full nanoodle share link with its #g=, #j= or #a= fragment (short links are refused here). Pass url OR graph.

graph.description: A custom workflow graph you composed: { "nodes": [{ "id", "type", "name"?, "fields": {...} }], "links": [{ "from": { "node", "port" }, "to": { "node", "port" } }] } (an object, or the same as a JSON string). Call noodle_guide for the node types, ports and priced models. Pass url OR graph.

inputs.description: Text inputs keyed by input name, e.g. { "Idea": "a lighthouse at dawn" }; this paid server accepts no media inputs. Omit to use the graph's saved text.

_pay_with.description: Payment asset on NEAR. Default near; choose usdc for a USDC quote. The quoted asset also determines the refund asset.

tools.name: noodle_guide
tools.description: Free, never charged: how to write a custom nanoodle workflow graph for run_noodle — the node types this server runs (inputs, outputs, key fields), the wiring rules, a complete example graph, hosted NanoGPT model candidates with their unit prices, and local slice-3d and sprite-stack-render wiring. Filter with `kind`, `node_type`, `search` (model ID substring) and `limit`. Use `format_only` to skip catalog reads. Then check the estimated cost with price_noodle before calling run_noodle.

kind.description: Only list models of this kind.

search.description: Only list models whose id contains this text.

node_type.description: Look up a node and limit model candidates to its catalog. Local sprite nodes have no model catalog.

format_only.description: Return the graph format, rules and example without looking up models.
